stepTitle: How much of a single-stage rocket that is $$100{, }000\, \text{kg}$$ can be anything but fuel if the rocket is to have a final speed of $$8.00\,\text{km/s},$$ given that it expels gases at an exhaust velocity of $$2.20\times10**{3}\,\text{m/s}?$$ Give the mass to three significant figures (in $$\text{kg})$$.
